title: Minuta 2025-01-28
summary: The minutes of the January 2025 meeting show all five Council members voting to hold the policy rate at 5%, with holding seen as the only plausible option. The discussion is more hawkish than the communique of the same meeting: the Council agreed that the drift of two-year inflation expectations above target was the most striking factor and an alert signal the Bank could not let pass, recalling episodes where de-anchored expectations required a much more aggressive policy reaction. Several members stressed readiness to do whatever is necessary, the hold was framed as leaving the door open to reassess the monetary strategy in the next IPoM, and one Councillor wanted it made clear that the Bank was willing to reverse direction and raise rates if needed, though not as the most likely outcome. Trend inflation measures were rising broadly and short-term projections pointed to around 5% in early 2025, while activity and labor gaps were seen as limited. As the first BCCh minutes in the base there is no previous minutes to compare against; versus the communique, the minutes reveal a Council more worried about expectations and openly discussing a hawkish turn.

key_quotes.quote: Todos los Consejeros concordaron en que la única opción plausible para esta Reunión era mantener la TPM en 5%.
key_quotes.context: Hold was the only option on the table; no cut considered

key_quotes.quote: De todos modos, era una señal de alerta que el Banco no podía dejar pasar, porque se podría terminar afectando la dinámica inflacionaria.
key_quotes.context: Two-year expectations above target seen as an alert signal

key_quotes.quote: Un Consejero agregó que se debía dejar claro que la Institución actuaría con la severidad adecuada, lo que implicaba estar dispuesta a cambiar la dirección de la política monetaria y mover las tasas hacia arriba, si ello era necesario.
key_quotes.context: One Councillor flags readiness to hike if needed

key_quotes.quote: Las brechas de actividad y del mercado laboral eran acotadas.
key_quotes.context: Limited activity and labor slack; no dovish argument from growth
